Target files: litellm/caching/caching.py, litellm/llms/openai/embeddings/guardrail_translation/handler.py, litellm/llms/vertex_ai/gemini_embeddings/batch_embed_content_transformation.py. - Adds explicit text inputs ({"type":"text","text":"..."}) for Gemini and Vertex embeddings, so text resembling a URL or file reference is treated literally. - Preserves existing media detection for ordinary string inputs. - Returns HTTP 400 for invalid media inputs instead of HTTP 500... (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/53135)

workarounds.symptom: clai2: session namer hard-codes max_tokens=250, so reasoning models fail with OutputTokenLimitExceeded
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Turn Pax background session naming back on, with minimal reasoning and room to answer on reasoning models. Target files: src/pydantic_ai_pax/pydantic_ai_pax/config/__init__.py, src/pydantic_ai_pax/pydantic_ai_pax/plugins/__init__.py, src/pydantic_ai_pax/pydantic_ai_pax/runtime/session_naming.py. Background session naming in Pax could fail on reasoning models, and was off by default. This PR makes naming reliable on reasoning models and turns it back on by default. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/14089)

workarounds.symptom: `db_vacuum` Docket jobs run concurrently against a size-1 maintenance pool and time out hourly
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Run db vacuum tasks one at a time on the maintenance pool. Target files: src/prefect/server/services/db_vacuum.py, tests/server/services/test_db_vacuum.py. This PR runs the database vacuum tasks one at a time, so they stop failing with pool checkout timeouts on the one-connection maintenance pool. Queued vacuum calls keep their current shape, so released and upgraded servers can run each other's calls during a rolling upgrade. (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23742)

workarounds.symptom: WebCodecs video render collapses every frame after the 2 s keyframe into one instant
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Give the in-page encoder's H.264 explicit frame times so long clips keep their length (#2759). Target files: scripts/frame-encoder.mjs, tests/fixtures/page-encoder-72-frames-24fps.h264, tests/render-media-audio-and-stills.test.js. The in-page WebCodecs encoder writes raw H.264 with no timing data, and ffmpeg guessed the frame times when copying it into the MP4. From the 51st frame on it gave every frame a 1 microsecond length, so a 4 s clip came out 2.08 s. The copy path now sets frame N to N / fps with the `setts` bitstre... (Ref: https://github.com/codepawl/crucible/pull/2785)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] Calendar event auto-backup fails with ENAMETOOLONG for long Microsoft calendar UID/recurrence IDs
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: bound filenames for long edit-backup identities. Target files: src/ha_mcp/backup_manager.py, src/ha_mcp/backup_snapshot_identity.py, src/ha_mcp/utils/config_write_lock.py. Updating or removing a recurring calendar event could succeed even when HA-MCP failed to save its pre-edit backup. The provider UID and recurrence ID were part of the filename. A sufficiently long UID exceeded the filesystem’s filename limit and left the user without a rollback snapshot. (Ref: https://github.com/homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp/pull/3097)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] AI Gateway silently drops Anthropic `cache_control` on the normalized chat route (prompt caching unreachable)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Forward `cache_control` prompt caching markers on the AI Gateway chat route. Target files: mlflow/gateway/providers/anthropic.py, mlflow/gateway/providers/base.py, mlflow/gateway/providers/bedrock.py. Prompt caching does not work on the AI Gateway chat route today. A `cache_control` marker on a content part is dropped when the request is validated, a list-form `system` message fails with a `TypeError` on Anthropic, and Bedrock never sends `cachePoint` blocks. So every request pays the full input price. (Ref: https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/pull/27949)
